title: Re: You Tube Creative Cohorts and opportunities for LAC
source: Re: You Tube Creative Cohorts and opportunities for LAC
description:
Sounds interesting. LAC is revamping its comms team (copied) so I'm sure someone will be
interested in participating. We also have partnerships w journalist and journalist associations so
happy to spread the word.

relationships.title: Re: You Tube Creative Cohorts and opportunities for LAC
relationships.evidence:
On Wed, Jul 13, 2022 at 5:29 PM Chelsea Milko <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks for sharing!
+Nabila Baptiste for viz on the Marcela ask.
As for the offer to provide YT training to our DOCs, that all sounds really interesting and useful. I'd like
to share the details of the training with them and gauge levels of interest. Would you mind providing a
succinct description of what the training entails? I know many of our Mission-level communicators
are YT savvy already so it would be good to understand how we can tailor this to their needs and
interests.
Looking forward to learning more! Thanks much!
Chelsea Milko
Sr. Communications Advisor
Strategy and Program Office (SPO)
USAID | Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
On Wed, Jul 13, 2022 at 10:37 AM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Great.
Please let me know if there's a real interest and I'm happy to set something up to explore.
YT analytics is for creators to see through analytics the extent of their audience and how far their
reach is. So this is part of their training.
Please let me know and I'm happy to put you all in touch with YT and be there as well. They would
love to do this before the calendar year and would be great to see if there's an opportunity here.
On Wed, Jul 13, 2022 at 10:33 AM Luis Azurduy <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Sounds interesting. LAC is revamping its comms team (copied) so I'm sure someone will be
interested in participating. We also have partnerships w journalist and journalist associations so
happy to spread the word.
Also, what is YT's "backed analytics"?
On Tue, Jul 12, 2022 at 10:11 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Luis,
I hope you are doing well!
Josh Machleder and I met with You Tube a number of weeks ago on ways we might potentially
be able to partner with them on a number of initiatives. First of all, we have a single point of
contact (Josh Blumenfeld) who can address most issues for us. Second, YT has offered to do
trainings for USAID communicators (ie DOCs) in the region on effective use of YT. Finally, they
are looking to do an interesting partnership with us, called Creator Cohort. Since AA Escobari
has engaged with YT as well, I thought there might be some interest in LAC? The idea would be
at the country / regional level to convene 25 creators / journalists that could be provided with
start-up funds, equipment, and training on YT's backed analytics. YT would love to explore
doing this by the end of the calendar year. Is this something of interest to you and others at
Thanks so much, and please let me know! Feel free to tag others.
Vera
Luis Azurduy
Team Lead, Democracy, Human Rights and Governance
